title: The Vector of Station Meridian
author: Ada Vane
blurb: Jonah Yarrow, the caretaker of Earth's abandoned seed vault, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
